newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Solid Bunds aim at 102.39 near-term.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Solid Bunds aim at 102.39 near-term.

text.p: September Bund futures on LIFFE will look for a hike toward 102.39 on Thursday after receiving a prop that confirmed the uptrend on Wednesday, analysts said.
Ian Stannard, technical analyst at Chase in London, said support at 101.92 had been effective, signalling further gains.
"Given that we held 101.92 yesterday we'd be looking for a bounce now to initially test 102.14/17, and if we can break through there then we'd expect 102.39 to be targeted," Stannard said.
By 0705 GMT, September Bund futures were quoted 0.03 up on the day at 102.05.
Stannard said the Bund contract would initially aim to take out minor trendline resistance coming in at 102.14/17. But 102.39 was a more significant trendline on daily charts.
That level, if breached, would confirm the next move up towards 102.85 and 102.91, which marked a forward channel on weekly and daily charts, Stannard said.
If 101.92 fell, Stannard said Bunds would be vulnerable to further downside correction, possibly pulling back to 101.43 -- the low on June 30 and July 1.
September Bunds rallied to a new contract high of 102.17 on Wednesday, but finished lower at 102.02.
According to Donna Liu, technical analyst at DKB International in London, Bunds are likely to be boxed in a narrow range in the short-term.
"I perceive the downside as very limited," she said, but added, "I would say 102.25 is the maximum upside in the short term."

Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Futures said the penetration of 102.00 completed the bullish continuation pattern projecting the market higher towards 103.00 over the coming weeks.
